name: Lower from standing to sitting
short_description: Lower from standing to sitting once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can lower from standing to sitting in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Lower from standing to sitting means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Lower from standing to sitting in a fresh real-life scenario.
